rubric.pass_: Bounded scenario expectation verified; does not certify full product acceptance.
rubric.partial: Evidence exists and bounded behavior works, with the stated visible difference or unverified portion.
rubric.blocked: Required upstream counterpart unavailable at the exact pin; absence is explicit, with no substitute.

confidence.level: high for reproduction, hashes and bounded semantic checks; medium for visual quality assessment
confidence.would_change: A failed fingerprint/semantic check, changed image hash, missing frame, independent scientific review or native-input evidence can change the assessment.

baseline.limit: Committed manifests and observations compared. Prior PNGs were absent, so changed browser captures have no direct prior-image visual comparison.

limits: Offscreen Canvas plus synthetic PlotView replay; no physical input, native window, GPU or native accessibility certification.
VoiceOver remains paused. Semantic/source-table assertions do not establish screen-reader usability.
Only desktop DPR 1 viewports reviewed; no responsive/mobile or additional theme testing.
Wave C driver exercises clicks and semantic/source-table assertions; per-family keyboard/linked-selection traversal was not exercised. Wave B driver exercises both.
PNG exports visually inspected. SVGs parsed and hashes checked; PDFs checked by hash/header, without an independent vector/PDF rendering review.
No full project suite, installed-consumer/package CI, independent human/scientific acceptance or performance certification. Host was heavily loaded.
